name: ollama-cloud-chat-provider
description: Language model provider for VS Code Chat using Ollama Cloud (ollama.com). Dynamic model discovery via /v1/models + /api/show. Not local Ollama.

ollamaCloud.apiKey.markdownDescription: Ollama Cloud API key. Prefer **Ollama Cloud: Set API Key** (Secret Storage) over this setting. Env `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is also used when set.

ollamaCloud.baseUrl.description: Ollama Cloud base URL (no trailing slash). OpenAI-compatible API is at {baseUrl}/v1.

ollamaCloud.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to re-discover models from the API (0 = only on demand / activation).

ollamaCloud.toolsOnly.description: Only list models that report tool-calling capability via /api/show. Turn off to list every model from /v1/models.

ollamaCloud.defaultMaxTokens.markdownDescription: Override max output tokens. **`0` = auto** (models.dev `limit.output`, else derived from context). Only set a positive number to force a fixed cap for all models.

ollamaCloud.useModelsDevRegistry.markdownDescription: Enrich discovery with [models.dev](https://models.dev) `ollama-cloud` catalog (max output tokens, reasoning effort options). Live Ollama Cloud API remains the source of model ids and capabilities.

ollamaCloud.defaultThinkingLevel.markdownDescription: Default **Thinking Effort**. **auto** = lowest/off by default, raises for complex/agent tasks. Per-request picker overrides this.

ollamaCloud.includeReasoningInResponse.markdownDescription: If true, append the model’s `reasoning` stream as a collapsible block after the answer. Off by default (reasoning still affects the answer via API).

ollamaCloud.debug.description: Log requests and discovery to the “Ollama Cloud” output channel.
